text:
nisha_data: heads up — i've been digging into console telemetry storage. our ingest cost is spiking for long attribute maps. thinking we should normalize common attrs into a small fixed column set + compact JSON blob for the rest.
ben_platform: what do you mean by 'fixed column set'? which attrs?
eva_pm: can you outline the user-facing tradeoffs? i.e., query UX on dashboards and retention consequences.
nisha_data: proposal sketch: extract {tenant_id, route_id, event_kind, timestamp, size_bytes} into columns. everything else goes into compacted_attrs -> gzip(base64(json)). means most queries are fast for dashboards and quotas, but ad-hoc attribute searches need an index on compacted_attrs or a lookup service.
jason_eng: sounds reasonable. concern: how does this affect quota enforcement which depends on route tags? we need route tags to be queryable without decompress.
ben_platform: yep — we should keep the tiny routing keys as first-class columns. maybe also keep a small vtag array of top-3 indexed attributes we see often.
laura_sre: operationally, backfill plan? decompressing blobs at query time is expensive. we should avoid a full table rewrite if possible.
nisha_data: agreed. plan A: dual-write for 30d, run streaming job to populate columns for new rows, and backfill in small batches for hot tenants. fallback queries still scan compacted_attrs for cold tenants.
eva_pm: for rollout UX — add a console toggle to show ‘normalized view’ vs raw event JSON so product folks can verify. keep default as normalized view.
jason_eng: implementation notes: we'll add new columns with default null, update producer lib to populate keys. streaming job in flink will emit UPDATE for new keys once it sees them. sample SQL:```ALTER TABLE console_events ADD COLUMN route_tags text[]; UPDATE console_events SET route_tags = parsed->'route_tags' WHERE parsed ? 'route_tags' LIMIT 10000;```
ben_platform: for queries that need full text search on attributes we can add a small inverted index table: attr_index(attr_key text, attr_value text, event_id uuid) sharded by tenant. populate from compacted_attrs asynchronously.
isha_data: storage estimate: compacting + gzip should reduce per-event size ~40% on average for our telemetry traces. cost savings pretty material.
laura_sre: monitoring: add metrics for dual-write failure rate, update lag from streaming job, and a gauge for rows still null-in-normalized-columns. alert if lag > 15m or null-rate > 5% for top-100 tenants.
deploy-bot: migration-plan: dual-write rollout staged by tenant cohorts: alpha (internal) -> beta (50 tenants) -> prod. scheduled window: 2026-05-18 03:00-07:00 UTC.
eva_pm: timeline + owners: nisha leads schema design, jason implements producer + streaming job, ben adds attr_index, laura owns SLOs/alerts, i'll own console UX.
ben_platform: one more: ensure old queries using jsonb paths still work — add view console_events_raw -> returns parsed json for compatibility.
jason_eng: ack. i'll draft the PR and include migration playbook with backfill throttling knobs.
eva_pm: thanks team. next step: nisha to post a short RFC doc and a migration checklist, then schedule a 30m sync. :thumbsup:
nisha_data: i'll write the RFC today and drop the link here by EOD. :working_on_it:
